tokenize_route.loading_semantics: For the pinned upstream revision, the runner loads the named model before serving, and the tokenizer is initialized inside Runner.loadModel from the loaded model. Therefore this endpoint is not a no-load tokenizer-only route. Installed-binary parity remains unverified because the binary is vcs.modified=true.
tokenize_route.decision: Do not call this private route. Pinned source establishes that it tokenizes a raw text body with model tokenizer BOS policy, not a rendered chat request or multimodal image expansion. It cannot establish complete request fit.

safest_exact_counting_path: Bind claims to the exact installed model digests and Ollama binary SHA-256. The binary reports source revision f580b5484a58c8370c35d669555bf887783a3f68 but also vcs.modified=true, so treat the tagged source as a strong reference, not a proof of exact binary parity.

For text-only prompts, the pinned MLX implementation tokenizes the prompt as passed to the runner with its model tokenizer and AddBOS policy. The private /v1/tokenize endpoint exercises that tokenizer only after model loading; do not call it or warm/load a model just to count.

For the exact request, reproduce the Ollama request construction and model-specific renderer/parser behavior, including prompt format, system/user boundaries, thinking, schema/format, stop/suffix tokens, and image placeholders. `ollama show` template {{ .Prompt }} is not itself the rendered chat prompt when renderer_parser supplies a renderer.

Pinned MLX Prepare code chooses a text-only encode path when no media is present, and a MediaModel.expandMedia path for media; resulting prepared tokens are then context-checked. Exact image expansion requires matching model-specific processor/media implementation and exact image bytes.

Qwen and Gemma have model-specific processor assets; Muse Glimmer has no preprocessor/processor config asset in the recorded manifest inventory. Keep image token contribution and total multimodal fit unknown until each model processor path is identified and independently validated.

Record per-unit request/rendered-input hashes, image payload SHA-256s, model digest, renderer/parser/tokenizer/processor source versions, text token IDs/count, image token contribution, context length, output reserve, and fit result.
